decisions.reason: The product-smooth-structure proposition has no AC_omega premise. The Definition now attributes the retained choice assumption exactly to def-gr-smooth-lorentzian-objects(c), whose tangent-bundle structure assumes it. The globally defined product metric and timelike field are unchanged. The digest unit defect is also repaired: polar angular metric coefficients have units m^2, while g_00 and g_11 are dimensionless.

At zero common coordinate duration both proper-time increments vanish, so the original quotient was 0/0. Clause (d) now requires a nonzero increment and step 3.1 verifies the denominator. Clause (c) also limits its smaller-than-coordinate-time inequality to positive increments; for reversed endpoints the inequality reverses. The unit field, all-real integral curves, proper-time identity and global acceleration computation remain valid.

The 7/8 scalar-composition expansion and the 1/8 difference are algebraically correct, but calling argument substitution a radial metric conversion omits the basis Jacobian. Retained all sound scalar comparisons and added the exact identity g_rr=(1+s/(4 rho_0))^4(rho_0_prime)^2=f^-1 with the squared-Jacobian second-order coefficient 1/8. Thus the radial tensor components agree exactly after full conversion; no physical mismatch is claimed.

The positive-derivative monotonicity assertion is true but lacked the exact chain-rule and mean-value suppliers. Added thm-chain-rule for differentiation on the open positive domains and cor-mean-value-theorem for every compact subinterval of (s,infinity); step 2.1 now states its hypotheses and positive difference explicitly. The fixed positive duration already in the Example is carried to Given and L1, so the corrected clock supplier applies.

The cited curvature interfaces require a time-oriented four-manifold, whereas det(q)<0 permits a non-time-orientable base. The formulas themselves are valid. Added step 2.4: a fixed timelike base vector at an arbitrary point remains timelike on a neighborhood; its lift supplies the required local orientation. Unique Levi-Civita restrictions and curvature/contraction formulas independent of N glue on overlaps. Checked all base, mixed and sphere Ricci sums; no global-orientation hypothesis or statement restriction is introduced.

L3 incorrectly claimed that arbitrary component identities retain their numerical form under every chart change. Replaced it with the tensor transformation law and intrinsic vanishing/contraction claims. The Statement already limits component tables to spherical-polar product charts; checked the six curvature entries, zero unequal-pair entries, Ricci contractions, f-specialization and continuity at poles. Those computations establish every stated conclusion without the false L3 generalization.

The two-dimensional field was incorrectly called Killing in the sense of a four-dimensional supplier. Retained its full claim, defined the base Lie derivative using the dimension-independent flow definition and coordinate proposition, and expanded metric compatibility to prove L_xi q = nabla_A xi_B + nabla_B xi_A locally. Checked parallel volume form, pure-trace curvature, Hessian reduction, mass constancy and K norm/components. Also supplied the exact connected-open zero-differential theorem and smooth-square-root/logarithm derivative suppliers; no new mathematical item is needed.

The coordinate criterion in L4/L5 required the inverse-function theorem, absent from deps. Added the existing choice-free smooth Euclidean lemma and applied it to F=(u1,r), whose determinant is partial_u2 r != 0 because K(r)=0 and z!=0. Checked base Lie-derivative zero from the repaired supplier, cross-term removal H_prime=F/E, diagonal inverse z=1/q_rr and both signs of z. Supplied FTC and zero-derivative uses exactly; an explicit timelike field on the local rectangle licenses the four-dimensional Killing definition without assuming global time orientability.

The assigned flat-example citation is a nonfatal overstatement, repaired by direct field-law substitution. Full review also confirms a fatal original Statement(b) defect: at Delta t=0 the clock quotient is 0/0. Statement(b), L2 and proof 1.2 now require nonzero common duration and verify the denominator. Vacuum validity, nonflat curvature and mass-parameter deductions remain conditional, with no measured inputs.

L3 restated exterior-only curvature suppliers as applying to f<0. Replaced it with the existing advanced-extension lemma(d), whose explicit interface covers every r>0, and proved the smooth branch isometry Phi_b with dv=dx0+f^-1 dr on both (0,s) and (s,infinity). Checked that the extension proof uses rational Christoffel/Ricci identities on both branches, not an interior orthonormal frame with sqrt(f). Isometry transfers its invariants; smoothness/density extends them across axes and poles. Also supplied mean-value monotonicity and proved the four connected components.

The Statement(c) already fixes ell_r^2=c^2 s r^2/(2r-3s) before differentiating in the independent radial variable. L1 omitted that essential condition and was false for general ell (ell=0 gives V_second=-c^2 s/r^3). Repaired L1 and step 1.3 to carry fixed ell and the circular substitution explicitly. Checked supplier(c), its endpoint factorization at r=3s, timelike existence/necessity and the nonzero-angular-momentum future null orbit. No physical prediction or empirical qualification changes.

The bijection corollary interface alone does not supply exponential order preservation. Added its exact strictly-increasing theorem; inversion gives log t<-M iff t<exp(-M), proving the stated negative-infinite limit. Verified Phi preserves r>s, horizon determinant/inertia and finite invariant, and the coordinate divergence for any approaching sequence. Added an explicit sequence r_n=s+s/n with v_n=0 so the approach and closure claim are nonvacuous. The refuted statement is unchanged.

The original physical scope called the full Kruskal level r=s a smooth null hypersurface. Since r=s iff UV=0, it is instead the union of the smooth null hypersurfaces U=0 and V=0. Their tangent spaces span all four dimensions at U=V=0, so the union is not a smooth hypersurface there. The existing repair states the transverse intersection and preserves the smooth advanced horizon, the right-exterior escape boundary, finite horizon curvature and the C2 obstruction at r=0.

## Example

Let $(M,g,N)$ be the Schwarzschild exterior datum with Schwarzschild radius
$s>0$, $f(r)=1-s/r$ ([[def-gr-schwarzschild-exterior-model]]), with the
circular-orbit data of
[[lem-gr-schwarzschild-circular-orbits-and-photon-sphere]

ledger_updates.affected_use: L3 gives the correct explicit frame-transformation law, then says its component identities are chart independent.

ledger_updates.snippet: [L3] Curvature components transform as those of a $(0,4)$-tensor: if $e_{\hat a}=d_{\hat a}{}^\mu\partial_\mu$ are the coefficients of a frame field, then the frame components of the lowered curvature are $\hat R_{\hat a\hat b\hat c\hat d}=d_{\hat a}{}^\alpha d_{\hat b}{}^\beta d_{\hat c}{}^\gamma d_{\hat d}{}^\delta R_{\alpha\beta\gamma\delta}$ evaluated on the same chart domain; the tensor $R$ is smooth and its component identities are chart independent ([[thm-gr-curvature-tensoriality-and-coordinate-formula]] clauses (a)-(b), [[def-gr-tensor-fields-and-components]], [[thm-gr-curvature-algebraic-symmetries]]).
